questions.question:
[지문]
When the weather got nice and warm, Bob and Bobby sat side by side. The summer breeze with the smell of happiness was blowing.
"You taught me how to walk. Do you remember?" Bobby said.
Then, Bob stood up very slowly. Bobby smiled and stood in front of Bob. Bob leaned on Bobby's shoulders.
Bobby said, "When I was little, you held my hands and said these words." And Bobby added, "Now one foot."
Like magic, Bob moved one foot.
"Now the other."
And Bob moved the other.

다음 글을 읽고 '바비(Bobby)'의 심경으로 추론할 수 있는 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 Bobby가 Bob과 함께 좋은 날씨에 앉아있고, Bob을 도와 걷도록 격려하고 있는 모습이 나타난다. 'Like magic'이라는 표현과 'The summer breeze with the smell of happiness'라는 표현을 통해 Bobby의 긍정적이고 희망적인 심경을 알 수 있다.

options: 밥이 큰 소리로 재채기를 했기 때문에
밥이 바비의 말에 반응을 보였기 때문에
밥이 침대에서 일어나 블록을 만졌기 때문에
밥이 코끼리 블록을 치워달라고 말했기 때문에
questions.question:
[지문]
Bob came back home after a few months. He just lay in bed without talking or moving. After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks.
"Bob, it's time to build a tower!"
Bob's mouth made a small smile. Bobby began to build the tower.
"Okay, Bob, now the elephant block."
Suddenly, Bob made a small sound like sneezing. At that moment, Bobby realized that Bob would recover soon. And Bob did. Slowly, Bob began to talk a little and move his fingers. But he still couldn't walk.

다음 글을 읽고 "Bobby realized that Bob would recover soon"이라고 생각한 이유로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문의 'Suddenly, Bob made a small sound like sneezing. At that moment, Bobby realized that Bob would recover soon.'에서 Bob이 작은 소리를 내며 반응을 보인 것이 회복의 신호로 보인 것이다. 이전에 Bob은 '말도 하지 않고 움직이지도 않았지만', 이제 소리를 내는 것으로 반응을 보였기 때문이다.

options: Eric은 할머니와 함께 런던에 여행 중이다.
할머니는 런던에서 Big Ben에 갈 예정이다.
Eric과 할머니는 서로 다른 시간대에 있다.
할머니는 런던에서 매일 아침 일찍 일어난다.
Eric은 할머니가 미트 파이를 먹는 것을 보았다.
questions.question:
[지문]
W: Hello, Eric. How are you doing?
B: I'm doing okay, thanks. How's your trip to London, Grandma?
W: It's great. I went to Big Ben and had a meat pie yesterday.
B: Wow! You're having a great time there. By the way, what time is it in London now?
W: It's a quarter past six in the morning.
B: Oh, you woke up early! I hope you have a wonderful vacation there.

다음 대화를 읽고 Eric과 할머니에 대해 추론할 수 있는 것은?
questions.explanation: 할머니가 런던에서 아침 6시 15분이라고 말하고, Eric이 '이 시간에 깨었나요?'라고 놀라는 것으로 보아, Eric이 있는 지역과 할머니가 있는 런던의 시간이 다르다는 것을 알 수 있다. 또한 Eric은 할머니와 함께 여행 중이 아니며, 할머니는 이미 Big Ben에 다녀왔고, 미트 파이를 어제 먹었다.

options: 과거와 현재 모두 밥이 바비를 가르치고 있다.
밥이 바비에게 했던 말이, 이제는 바비가 밥에게 하는 말이 되었다.
밥과 바비는 걷는 것을 싫어했지만, 어쩔 수 없이 연습하고 있다.
바비는 밥이 했던 말을 기억하지 못해서 다른 말을 하고 있다.
밥은 과거에도 현재에도 걷는 것을 매우 어려워했다.
questions.question:
[지문]
When the weather got nice and warm, Bob and Bobby sat side by side. The summer breeze with the smell of happiness was blowing.
"You taught me how to walk. Do you remember?" Bobby said.
Then, Bob stood up very slowly. Bobby smiled and stood in front of Bob. Bob leaned on Bobby's shoulders.
Bobby said, "When I was little, you held my hands and said these words." And Bobby added, "Now one foot."
Like magic, Bob moved one foot.
"Now the other."
And Bob moved the other.

다음 글의 "Now one foot." "Now the other."라는 말이 사용된 두 상황(과거와 현재)을 비교하여 추론한 내용으로 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 과거에는 Bob이 Bobby를 도와 'Now one foot. Now the other.'라고 말했고, 현재에는 Bobby가 회복 중인 Bob에게 같은 말을 하고 있다. 이는 역할의 변화를 보여주는 것으로, 학생과 교사의 역할이 바뀐 것을 의미한다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Time passed. One day, Bobby's dad looked very sad. He told Bobby, "Bob fell ill. He is in a ⓐ hospital which is far from here." "I want to see him," Bobby said. "You can't, Bobby," Mom told him. "He can't move his arms and legs, and he can't talk. We'll just have to ⓑ leave and ⓒ hope that he will get better."
Bob came back home after a few months. He just lay in bed without talking or moving. After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks. "Bob, it's time to build a tower!" Bob's mouth made a small smile. Bobby began to build the tower. "Okay, Bob, now the elephant block." Suddenly, Bob made a small ⓓ sound like sneezing. At that moment, Bobby realized that Bob would ⓔ recover soon. And Bob did. Slowly, Bob began to talk a little and move his fingers. But he still couldn't walk.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: "We'll just have to ⓑ leave and ⓒ hope"에서 'leave'는 문맥상 부자연스럽다. '우리는 그냥 기다리고 그가 나아지기를 바라야 한다'는 의미이므로 'leave'대신 'wait'이 적절하다. 다른 선지들(hospital, hope, sound, recover)은 모두 문맥상 적절하게 사용되었다.

questions.question:
다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?

When the weather got nice and warm, Bob and Bobby sat side by side. ① The summer breeze with the smell of happiness was blowing. ② The summer breeze was also very cold. ③ "You taught me how to walk. Do you remember?" Bobby said. ④ Then, Bob stood up very slowly. Bobby smiled and stood in front of Bob. ⑤ Bob leaned on Bobby's shoulders. Bobby said, "When I was little, you held my hands and said these words." And Bobby added, "Now one foot." Like magic, Bob moved one foot. "Now the other." And Bob moved the other.
questions.explanation: "The summer breeze with the smell of happiness was blowing"이라고 행복함의 냄새가 나는 상큼한 바람이라고 표현한 직후, "The summer breeze was also very cold"라고 '춥다'는 것은 앞의 행복한 분위기와 모순된다. 이 문장이 제거되면 전체 흐름이 더 자연스럽다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Time passed. One day, Bobby's dad looked very ⓐsad. He told Bobby, "Bob fell ill. He is in a hospital ⓑwhere is far from here." "I want to see him," Bobby said. "You can't, Bobby," Mom told him. "He can't move his arms and legs, and he can't talk. We'll just have to wait and ⓒhope that he will get better." Bob came back home after a few months. He just ⓓlay in bed without talking or moving. After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks. "Bob, it's time to build a tower!" Bob's mouth made a small smile. Bobby began to build the tower. "Okay, Bob, now the elephant block." Suddenly, Bob made a small sound like sneezing. At that moment, Bobby realized ⓔthat Bob would recover soon.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: "hospital ⓑwhere is far from here"는 어법상 잘못되었다. 관계대명사 where 뒤의 동사는 'is'가 아니라 'which is' 또는 'that is'로 표현되어야 한다. 올바른 표현은 "hospital which is far from here" 또는 "hospital that is far from here"이다.

questions.question:
[지문]
B: Mom, is it okay if I ⓐuse your computer?
W: What do you need it ⓑfor?
B: I need ⓒfind some information for my homework.
W: Okay, but I need to use the computer ⓓin the evening.
B: Don't worry. I'll finish ⓔbefore then.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: "I need ⓒfind some information"는 어법상 잘못되었다. 'need' 뒤에는 to 부정사가 와야 하므로 "I need to find some information"으로 표현되어야 한다. 다른 선지들(use, for, in, before)은 모두 문법적으로 올바르게 사용되었다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Bobby got his name (A)__________ his grandfather, Bob. Bob was his best friend. Bob was the person who taught Bobby how (B)__________ walk. "Hold my hands, Bobby," Bob said. "Now one foot, now the other."
Bob and Bobby often played (C)__________ old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks one by one to build a tower. "There is one more block to put," Bob said. "And that's the elephant block," Bobby said. Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top.

다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 'Bobby got his name from/by his grandfather' - 할아버지의 이름을 따서 이름을 지었으므로 'from' 또는 'by'가 가능하지만, 더 자연스러운 것은 'from'이다. 하지만 '~의 이름을 따서'라는 의미로는 'by'가 적절하다. (B) 'taught Bobby how to walk' - to 부정사가 필요하다. (C) 'played with old wooden blocks' - 함께 ~를 하다는 의미로 'with'가 적절하다. 정답은 (A) by (B) to (C) with이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 조건에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 6번째 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

[지문]
Bobby got his name from his grandfather, Bob. Bob was his best friend. Bob was the person who taught Bobby how to walk. "Hold my hands, Bobby," Bob said. "Now one foot, now the other." Bob and Bobby often played with old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks one by one to build a tower. "There is one more block to put," Bob said. "And that's the elephant block," Bobby said. Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. But Bob sneezed, and the tower fell. Bobby laughed and laughed. Bobby said, (A) "코끼리 블록이 나타나면 할아버지는 항상 재채기를 해요."

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것. (총 8단어)
- 단어: block / appears / elephant / the / when / sneeze / always / You
questions.explanation: 문장 구조: You always sneeze when the elephant block appears. 6번째 단어는 'always'입니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

[지문]
Time passed. One day, Bobby's dad ⓐlooked very sad. He told Bobby, "Bob fell ill. He is in a hospital ⓑwhich is far from here." "I want to see him," Bobby said. "You can't, Bobby," Mom told him. "He can't move his arms and legs, and he can't talk. We'll just have ⓒto wait and hoping that he will get better."

Bob came back home after a few months. He just ⓓlay in bed without talking or moving. After a while, Bobby ⓔcame into Bob's room with the blocks.
questions.explanation: ⓒ에서 "to wait and hoping"은 병렬구조가 맞지 않습니다. "to wait and (to) hope" 또는 "waiting and hoping"으로 일관성 있게 표현되어야 합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 조건에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 4번째 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

[지문]
When the weather got nice and warm, Bob and Bobby sat side by side. The summer breeze with the smell of happiness was blowing. "You taught me how to walk. Do you remember?" Bobby said. (A) 그런 다음, Bob은 매우 천천히 일어섰다. Bobby smiled and stood in front of Bob. Bob leaned on Bobby' shoulders. Bobby said, "When I was little, you held my hands and said these words." And Bobby added, "Now one foot." Like magic, Bob moved one foot. "Now the other." And Bob moved the other.

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것. (총 6단어)
- 단어: slowly / up / Bob / stood / very / Then,
questions.explanation: 문장 구조: Then, Bob stood up very slowly. 4번째 단어는 'very'입니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 조건에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 8번째 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

[지문]
Subin: Dad, is it okay if I use the oven to bake some cookies?
Dad: Sure, you can, Subin. What are they for?
Subin: Today is Kate's birthday, so I want to bake them for her.
Dad: That's very nice of you. What time is it now?
Subin: It's a quarter past two.
Dad: I have an online meeting at 4, so I can help you now.
Subin: That's great!
Dad: (A) 어떤 종류의 쿠키를 구울 거니?
Subin: Cheese cookies. Kate loves them.
Dad: Okay. Let's start.

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것. (총 9단어)
- 단어: are / kind / going / bake / cookies / to / What / of / you
questions.explanation: 문장 구조: What kind of cookies are you going to bake? 8번째 단어는 'of'입니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

[지문]
Bob came back ⓐ home after a few months. He just lay in bed without talking or moving. After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks.
"Bob, it's time to build a tower!"
Bob's mouth made a small ⓑ frown. Bobby began to build the tower.
"Okay, Bob, now the elephant block."
Suddenly, Bob made a small ⓒ sound like sneezing. At that moment, Bobby realized that Bob would ⓓ recover soon. And Bob did. Slowly, Bob began to ⓔ talk a little and move his fingers. But he still couldn't walk.
questions.explanation: ⓑ에서 'frown'은 명사이므로 "made a small frown"이 문법적으로는 맞지만, 문맥상 "made a small smile"이 더 적절합니다. Bob이 tower를 짓자는 말에 긍정적으로 반응하는 장면이기 때문입니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

[지문]
When the weather got ⓐnice and warm, Bob and Bobby sat ⓑside by side. The summer breeze with the smell of happiness was blowing. "You taught me how to walk. Do you remember?" Bobby said. Then, Bob stood up very slowly. Bobby smiled and stood ⓒin front of Bob. Bob leaned ⓓ on Bobby' shoulders. Bobby said, "When I was little, you held my hands and said these words." And Bobby added, "Now one foot." Like magic, Bob moved one foot. "Now the other." And Bob ⓔwas moved the other.
questions.explanation: ⓔ에서 "was moved"는 수동태이지만, 문맥상 "moved"(능동태)가 올바릅니다. Bob이 주어이고 자신의 발을 움직이는 행동이므로 능동태가 적절합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

[지문]
Bobby ⓐgot his name from his grandfather, Bob. Bob ⓑwas his best friend. Bob was the person who taught Bobby how to walk. "Hold my hands, Bobby," Bob said. "Now one foot, now the other." Bob and Bobby often ⓒplayed with old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks one by one to build a tower. "There is one more block ⓓto put," Bob said. "And that's the elephant block," Bobby said. Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. But Bob ⓔsneezing, and the tower fell.
questions.explanation: ⓔ에서 "Bob sneezing"은 불완전한 표현입니다. "Bob sneezed"(과거형)로 수정되어야 합니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

[지문]
Time passed. One day, Bobby's dad looked very sad. He told Bobby, "Bob fell ________. He is in a hospital which is far from here." "I want to see him," Bobby said. "You can't, Bobby," Mom told him. "He can't move his arms and legs, and he can't talk. We'll just have to wait and hope that he will get better."
questions.explanation: "Bob fell ill"은 "Bob이 병에 걸렸다"는 의미로, 문맥상 가장 적절합니다. Bob이 병원에 있고 움직일 수 없는 상황과 일치합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 (A), (B), (C) 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은?

[지문]
Bob came back home after a few months. He just lay in bed without talking or moving. After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks. "Bob, it's time to build a tower!" Bob's mouth made a small smile. Bobby began to build the tower. "Okay, Bob, now the elephant block." Suddenly, Bob made a small (A) [sound / cry] like sneezing. At that moment, Bobby realized that Bob would (B) [get better / go back] soon. And Bob did. Slowly, Bob began to talk a little and move his fingers. But he still couldn't (C) [walk / talk].
questions.explanation: (A) 재채기 소리는 'sound'가 적절합니다. (B) Bob이 나아질 것이므로 'get better'입니다. (C) 마지막 문장에서 아직 걸을 수 없다고 했으므로 'walk'입니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 (A), (B), (C) 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은?

[지문]
Time passed. One day, Bobby's dad looked very (A) [sad / happy]. He told Bobby, "Bob fell ill. He is in a hospital which is (B) [far from / near] here." "I want to see him," Bobby said. "You can't, Bobby," Mom told him. "He can't move his arms and legs, and he can't (C) [talk / walk]. We'll just have to wait and hope that he will get better."
questions.explanation: (A) Bob이 병원에 있으므로 dad는 'sad'합니다. (B) 병원이 멀리 있으므로 'far from'입니다. (C) 문맥상 팔과 다리를 움직일 수 없다고 했으므로 'talk'입니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 조건에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 3번째 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

[지문]
G1: Jina, is it okay if I wear your brown jacket?
G2: My brown jacket? I put it in the washing machine this morning, and it's not dry yet.
G1: Oh, no! I wanted to wear that jacket.
G2: (A) 너의 파란색 자켓을 입는 건 어때? It's warm today.
G1: That's a good idea. Thanks.

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것. (총 7단어)
- 단어: shirt? / your / wear / Why / don't / blue / you
questions.explanation: 문장 구조: Why don't you wear your blue shirt? 3번째 단어는 'wear'입니다.

options: Don't worry. I'll finish before then
Okay, but I need to use the computer
I need to find some information for my homework
Is it okay if I use your computer?
What do you need it for?
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

[지문]
B: Mom, is it okay if I use your computer?
W: What do you need it for?
B: __________________________________.
W: Okay, but I need to use the computer in the evening.
B: Don't worry. I'll finish before then.
questions.explanation: 엄마의 질문 "What do you need it for?"에 대한 답변으로 "I need to find some information for my homework"가 가장 적절합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. But Bob sneezed, and the tower fell.

주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 블록 탑이 무너졌다는 주어진 글 다음에, (B) Bobby가 웃으며 항상 코끼리 블록이 나오면 재채기를 한다고 말한다 (과거의 행복한 기억). (C) (장면이 전환되어) 시간이 흘러, 아빠가 슬퍼 보였다는 내용이 나온다. (A) 아빠가 슬픈 이유, 즉 Bob이 아파서 병원에 있다는 사실을 말하는 흐름이 자연스럽다.

options: Bobby의 아빠는 Bob이 아파서 슬퍼 보였다.
Bobby는 Bob을 만나러 가고 싶어 했다.
엄마는 지금은 Bob을 만날 수 없다고 말했다.
questions.question:
[지문]
Time passed. One day, Bobby's dad looked very sad. He told Bobby, "Bob fell ill. He is in a hospital which is far from here." "I want to see him," Bobby said. "You can't, Bobby," Mom told him. "He can't move his arms and legs, and he can't talk. We'll just have to wait and hope that he will get better."

다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문에 따르면, Bobby의 아빠는 Bob이 "far from here(여기서 멀리)" 있는 병원에 있다고 말했다. 따라서 '집에서 가까운 병원에 입원했다'는 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는다.

questions.question:
[지문]
When the weather got nice and warm, Bob and Bobby sat side by side. The summer breeze with the smell of happiness was blowing. "You taught me how to walk. Do you remember?" Bobby said.

주어진 글 다음에 이어질 (A)~(D)의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: Bobby가 걷는 법을 가르쳐 준 것을 기억하냐고 말한 주어진 글 다음에, (C) Bob이 천천히 일어서고 Bobby에게 기댄다. (A) Bobby가 어릴 때 Bob이 했던 말("이제 한 발")을 해준다. (D) 마법처럼 Bob이 한 발을 움직이고, Bobby가 "이제 다른 발"이라고 말한다. (B) 그리고 Bob이 다른 발을 움직였다는 흐름이 자연스럽다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Bob came back home after a few months. He just lay in bed without talking or moving. After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks. "Bob, it's time to build a tower!" Bob's mouth made a small ________. Bobby began to build the tower. "Okay, Bob, now the elephant block." Suddenly, Bob made a small sound like sneezing. At that moment, Bobby realized that Bob would get better soon.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: Bobby가 "탑을 쌓을 시간이에요!"라고 말하자, 말도 움직임도 없이 누워 있던 Bob의 입이 작은 '미소(smile)'를 지었다는 것이 문맥상 자연스럽다.
